title: Fine-tuned ResNet50 identifies hypertrophic and dilated cardiomyopathy from ECG images
summary: A fine-tuned ResNet50 was trained on 2849 12-lead ECG images (171 HCM, 364 DCM, 2314 healthy controls), with HCM and DCM confirmed by cardiovascular magnetic resonance. With stratified five-fold cross-validation it reached an AUROC of 0.996 (AUPRC 0.940) for DCM and 0.980 (AUPRC 0.953) for HCM. The abstract reports stable performance in temporal validation and Grad-CAM maps pointing to anterior and anteroseptal leads. Single-institution data and images rather than patients; no clinical outcome shown.
ai_technology: Fine-tuned ResNet50 convolutional network classifying 12-lead ECG images

evidence.tested: Cross-validated and temporally validated performance on single-institution ECG images against CMR-confirmed diagnoses.
evidence.unknown: Performance in other centers and in prospective clinical use; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Image classifier that separates HCM, DCM and healthy ECGs.
